description: One completed download, what letting it go would cost, and what became of it.

agreement.description:
What this offer names itself, so an answer to it can say which offer it
answered.

download.description:
The download, in the same words the account names it in: where it stands, what
it occupies, and what removing it costs.

goes.description: What goes with it, carried rather than left for a surface to remember.

gone.description: What became of an answered offer, and nothing where the offer is all this is.

rehearsed.description:
Whether this was a rehearsal: what would have happened, with none of it done.

Said in a field of its own so that a rehearsal is never told from the real run by
its wording alone.
